verdict.rationale: Phaser is an MIT-licensed library installed locally via npm, so game code stays with the user, and the pricing page says games keep working after a licence ends and project files can be moved to VS Code. Assets load from common open formats such as images, atlases, audio and JSON. However, nothing documents a full export of account or hosted data, such as projects built in the hosted Game Agent or Editor workspace. Missing for 10: documented export for hosted Game Agent/Editor projects and account data, explicit open-format guarantees for Editor scene files, independent hands-on confirmation of migrating away.
